lines.trans: Werner... Klara... please tell me that room six is free tonight.
No, Martin, the couple from the south moved in an hour ago.
All keys from one to seven are taken, and room eight is freshly painted.
A disaster! Yesterday I entered a booking on the tablet without my glasses!
Wait, show me the tablet and the paper book together.
Let me guess. You promised somebody a room that is already full?
Martin! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest!
And he arrives on the evening train at eight, in forty minutes!
I told you so, that tablet is a trap.
Outside it is raining, and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do now?
